en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town seen from a hillside with blossoming trees and a small shrine or monument in the foreground where a cloaked figure stands. In the middle distance are church towers and a large domed church, with a wide valley and fields stretching to distant hills. The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, a red Hungarian stamp, and printed caption information.
